g.text: A plausible patch must earn approval
Read the same issue through evidence, authorization, exact-artifact checks and a human change decision.
actual Git base, head, file set
Disproved or inconclusive: retain evidence; no remediation authority.
Changed context: reaccept. Changed patch: invalidate prior proof and review.
Reviewer differs from patch author. Approval
leaves the case open. Rollout and closure need
REFERENCE CONTRACT CWE-639 at src/invoices.mjs:3; verification only covers invoice-file changes.
Unsupported subjects or missing capability stay inconclusive. Local actor names are assertions; production must authenticate independent roles.
Ask: what must a correct fix preserve, and who can accept the remaining risk?
The issue, failed fix and corrected fix are source/test examples, not an app demonstration. A later empty scan cannot close the case.
